01

“Whoever brings a captive will have such and such, and whoever brings…”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 8:1).

295
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 295: 1: 7

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
295: 1:7. Sufyan, from al-Kalbi, from Abu Salih, from Ibn Abbas, who said:
The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said on the day of Badr: "Whoever brings a captive will have such and such, and whoever brings a head will have such and such." Abu al-Yusr came with two captives and said, "O Messenger of God, you said, 'Whoever brings a captive will have such and such, and whoever brings a head will have such and such,' and I have brought these two." Sad ibn Ubada said, "O Messenger of God, we saw where they took [the captives] and we guarded you for it, fearing for you." Abu al-Yusr began to speak, and when he finished, Sad ibn Ubada spoke. Then there was revealed "They ask you about the spoils of war. Say, the spoils belong to God and the Messenger" (verse 1).
العربية
295: 1: 7 سفيان عن الكلبي عن أبي ضلح قوله من بن عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ مَنْ جَاءَ بِأَسِيرٍ فَلَهُ كذى ومن جاء برأس فله كذى ومن جاء برأس فله كذى فَجَاءَ أَبُو الْيُسْرِ بِأَسِيرَيْنِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ من جاء بأسير فله كذى ومن جاء برأس فله كذى وَقَدْ جِئْتُ بِهَذَيْنِ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ رَأَيْنَا مَكَانَ مَا أَخَذُوا وحرسناك له مَخَافَةً عَلَيْكَ فَجَعَلَ أَبُو الْيُسْرِ يَتَكَلَّمُ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ تَكَلَّمَ سَعْدُ بن عبادة فنزلت يسئلونك عَنِ الأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ والرسول (الآية 1) .
Edition record 371354 · p. 115Link to report ↗

“Had it not been for a decree from God that preceded”

An explanation transmitted from Abū Hurayra (Q 8:68).

325
Explanation from Abū Hurayra No. 325: 31: 20

Abū Hurayra

English
Transmission wording
325: 31:20. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Dhakwan, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
Spoils were not lawful to any black-headed people before you; the spoils would [be gathered and] a fire would come down ⦗p. 122⦘ and consume them. So there was revealed "Had it not been for a decree from God that preceded": He said, it was foreordained in the prior Book (verse 68).
